long_biography.plain_text:
Wolstein worked alongside her husband, Bert, as a business partner in the real estate companies he founded. She became head of Heritage Development Company, overseeing its residential, commercial, industrial and hospitality properties and making final decisions on projects. After Bert's death, she continued the family's work with her son Scott, helping sustain the Flats East Bank redevelopment in Cleveland.

Wolstein's giving has funded scholarships, medical research, leadership programs and facilities at Cleveland State, Case Western Reserve, Ohio State and University Hospitals. Her philanthropy has also supported children's health programs. A major 2024 gift launched an education and training center at University Hospitals, extending a record of Cleveland-focused giving developed over decades.
